description:
## Problem
Untuned runs produce three bundle shapes:
- no `platform.tuning` at all (DuckDB);
- a tuning block whose only status is the nested `applied.status` (SQLite, ClickHouse);
- the full block.

`docs/reference/result-formats.md:178` describes a `.applied.json` companion that is no longer written, and says `validation_status` is omitted only for pre-ledger bundles.

## Change
- Always emit `platform.tuning.validation_status`, with `not_applicable` for untuned runs, consistent with `applied.status`.
- Confirm Explorer ingest handles it.
- Correct the docs.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Additive only; existing field names and shapes are unchanged (Explorer ingests verbatim).

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
